senses.gloss:
पृ I. €6 Ā. (प्रियते-पृत) To be busy or active (mostly with
 व्या); कार्ये व्याप्रियते; see व्यापृत. ━Caus. (पारयति-ते)
—1 To cause to work, engage upon, entrust, with, appoint to; (usually
 with loc.); व्यापारितः शूलमृता विधाय सिंहत्वमङ्कागतसत्त्ववृत्ति R. 2. 38.
—2 To place, set, fix, direct, cast; व्यापारयामास करं किरीटे R. 6. 19;
 उमामुखे … व्यापारयामास विलोचनानि Ku. 3. 67; व्यापारितं
 शिरसि शस्त्रमशस्त्रपाणेः Ve. 3. 19; R. 13. 25. ━II. €3 P. (पिपर्ति, पूर्ण)
—1 To bring or carry over.
—2 To deliver from, bring out of.
—3 To fill.
—4 To protect, maintain, sustain.
—5 To promote, advance. ━III. €9 P. (पृणाति) To protect.
━IV. €10 U. (पारयति-ते; sometimes पार् is regarded as a separate root.)
—1 To carry over or across, ferry over.
—2 To reach the other side of anything, accomplish, perform, achieve,
 bring to a conclusion (a vow &c.).
—3 To be able or capable; न खलु मातापितरौ भर्तृवियोगदुःखितां दुहितरं
 द्रष्टुं पारयतः Ś. 6; न पारयामि तातकाश्यपस्य … आपन्नसत्त्वां
 शकुन्तलां निवेदयितुम् Ś. 4; अधिकं न हि पारयामि वक्तुम् Bv. 2. 59.
—4 To deliver, save, extricate, rescue.
—5 To withstand, oppose.
—6 To live. ━V. €5 P. (पृणोति)
—1 To please or delight, gratify.
—2 To be pleased or delighted.

पॄ €3. €9 P. (पिपर्ति, पृणाति, पपार, अपारीत्, परि(री)ष्यति, परि(री)तुम्,
 पूर्ण; pass. पूर्यते; caus. पूरयति-ते; desid.
 पिपरिरी-षति, पुपूर्षति)
—1 To fill, fill up, complete.
—2 To fulfil, gratify (as hopes &c.).
—3 To fill with wind, blow (as a conch, flute &c.).
—4 To satisfy, refresh, please; पितॄनपारात् Bk. 1. 2.
—5 To rear, bring up, nourish, nurture, cherish.
